newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-J.Hardie says Firmandale exposure up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-J.Hardie says Firmandale exposure up.

text.p: Building materials supplier James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Wednesday its after tax exposure to Firmandale Investments Ltd has increased by A$500,000.

This was due to a further decline in American Endeavour Fund Ltd (AEF) net asset value based on its accounts at September 30, 1996, which fell to US$51.3 million from $52.1 million a year earlier, Hardie said.

"As a result of the dimunition in the net assets of AEF (75 percent of which flows to Firmandale), James Hardie considers that its after tax exposure under the guarantee has increased by approximately A$0.5 million," the company said.
The exposure arises under third party guarantee given in connection with the funding of Firmandale's investment in AEF.
Last month, James Hardie said its total after tax provision for its exposure to Firmandale was A$65 million.
At 11.10 a.m. (0010 GMT), James Hardie shares were four cents up at A$3.51.
